title: ISTP Scalar Magnetometer Total Field Skeleton
description: Minimal ISTP-compliant NASA CDF skeleton table storing total magnetic field magnitude |B| with monotonic EPOCH timestamps, UNITS, VALIDMIN, VALIDMAX, and FILLVAL.

title: 3-Axis Fluxgate Magnetometer RTN Vector Time-Series
description: Parker Solar Probe style 3-component RTN magnetic field vector time-series with ISTP metadata, vector VALIDMIN/VALIDMAX bounds, and total field magnitude.

title: Solar Wind Proton Density, Velocity & Temperature Moments
description: DSCOVR Faraday Cup solar wind plasma moments dataset containing proton number density, bulk GSE velocity vector, and thermal speed.

title: Energetic Particle Energy-Flux Spectrogram
description: Van Allen Probes ECT-REPT style differential electron energy flux spectrogram across 4 energy channels with non-record-varying energy bin support data.

title: Multi-Instrument Heliophysics Mission Skeleton (MAG + SWE + Ephemeris)
description: Combined MMS-class magnetospheric mission CDF merging triaxial magnetometer vectors, ion plasma density/velocity moments, spacecraft GSE ephemeris, and data quality flags.
